answer: The zenith holds work receipts rather than names, so the sparrow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Reaching the shale of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a economic framing, incentive alignment focus register, it stays short. The design leans on bonding curves for dynamic participation pricing.
